successDefinition.matchingSuccess: The unchanged matcher emits an accepted non-empty candidate set; one or multiple same-sound items are equally valid. No unique-item guess is required.
successDefinition.soundFamilyCorrectness: Verify that the candidate set belongs to the sound actually operated, when independent sound-family evidence exists. Missing one exact item name alone is not proof of failure.
successDefinition.falseOutput: Output does not correspond to the player item-operation scene; not labelled false merely because it contains multiple items.
successDefinition.legacyFields: legacyExpectedItemHits / legacyExpectedItemInCandidates and aligned correctAtCatalogThreshold are exact-ID diagnostics, not the user success criterion.

librarySwap.conversion: stored float32 * 32767, truncate to signed PCM16; 48 kHz mono, 0.45 seconds; no additional processing
librarySwap.catalogueAdaptation: one item and its supplied waveform per group; all 62 references, including duplicates, retained

reviewSelection: For each full recording, first three newly accepted outputs in chronological order, >=2 seconds apart; additionally every accepted output in both development movement clips. Fixed before visual inspection; not random sampling.
limitations: Only eight known operations covering five item identities; no overall gameplay accuracy estimate.
312 full-recording outputs are not 312 correct recognitions, nor all automatically labelled false; only explicit visual reviews count.
The library swap also changes catalogue coverage/group representation from 51 items/9 groups/14 references to 62 items/62 groups/62 references; matching code and thresholds remain frozen.
All 62 supplied pickup waveforms were imported; original putdown auxiliary library remains byte-identical because no separate peer putdown library was supplied.
The fixed threshold has not been recalibrated for the replacement library; these results do not isolate asset quality from algorithm/library compatibility.
Exact original mono 24 kHz PCM used for our frozen baseline, including compressed/mixed recording audio. This is not a live game-process capture or GUI test.
The 610-second September 23 cohort was used previously for development and is not an independent holdout.
Hidden trader goods have no identity ground truth. Output/trigger timing is measurable but correctness is not.
Manual aligned 0.44-second crops bypass the automatic trigger and are diagnostic only; no tuning on these labels.
Visual false labels mean the candidate output does not correspond to the player action; images do not isolate which overlapping sound caused it.
